crossRefs.note: “This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives…
King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also…
The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh…
In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all…
Why then didn’t you obey Yahweh’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight?”
This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh; but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great…
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I gave you your master’s house, and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.
translations.bsb: I gave your master’s house to you and your master’s wives into your arms. I gave you the house of Israel and Judah, and if that was not enough, I would have given you even more.
translations.kjv: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.
translations.asv: and I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would have added unto thee such and such things.
